title: CuRe: Cultural Gaps in the Long Tail of Text-to-Image Systems

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating text-to-image models on the CuRe dataset (300 cultural artifacts from 64 countries) using Marginal Information Attribution (MIA) scorers. The methodology measures how image generation quality (perceptual similarity, image-text alignment, and diversity) changes as prompt specificity increases (artifact name, category, and region), validating results against judgments from crowdsourced workers native to the specific cultures.

Comparing text-to-image model performance and image generation quality on cultural artifacts from regions in the Global North versus the Global South to highlight Amerocentric and Eurocentric performance gaps.

Conducting a large-scale user study where crowdsourced workers who identify with the target culture rate AI-generated images of their local artifacts on a Likert scale for offensiveness and the presence of cultural stereotypes.
